POPULATION EFFECTS: Small sample size (n=10) limits subgroup analysis, but responses were seen (1 CR, 1 PR) suggesting the mechanism may work in a subset. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This is a single-arm Phase 2 trial with very small sample size, making it severely underpowered. The trial demonstrates a classic 'biology moved, endpoint flat' pattern where the mechanism engaged but didn't translate to the primary efficacy endpoint.
